name: PC Rules 2011 + Amendments — Demo v1
description: Prototype rule pack for hackathon demonstration purposes only. Verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement. Rule conditions, dates, exemptions, and measurement methods have NOT been independently re-verified against the current, amended official text of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 and must be confirmed before any operational use.

rules.name: Generic/Common Name
rules.description: The package must declare the generic or common name of the commodity.
rules.applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities regardless of category or supply type.
rules.expected_condition: A generic/common name declaration must be present on the package.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing the generic/common name declaration. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Name
rules.description: The package must declare the name of the manufacturer, packer, or importer.
rules.applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities regardless of category or supply type.
rules.expected_condition: The name of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be present on the package.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing manufacturer/packer/importer identity. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Address
rules.description: The package must declare the address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer.
rules.applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities regardless of category or supply type.
rules.expected_condition: The address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be present on the package.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing manufacturer/packer/importer address. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Country of Origin
rules.description: Imported products must declare the country of origin.
rules.applicability: the product's supply type is Imported
rules.expected_condition: For imported products, the country of origin must be declared.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing country-of-origin declarations for imported packages. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Net Quantity
rules.description: The package must declare net quantity as a numeric value with a standard unit of measurement.
rules.applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities regardless of category or supply type.
rules.expected_condition: Net quantity must be declared with a numeric value and a standard unit of measurement.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing net quantity declarations and standard units. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.description: The package must declare MRP as a numeric amount, inclusive of all taxes.
rules.applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities regardless of category or supply type.
rules.expected_condition: MRP must be declared as a numeric amount, inclusive of all taxes.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing MRP declaration and inclusive-of-taxes wording. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Manufacturing / Packing / Import Date
rules.description: The package must declare the month and year (or date) of manufacture, packing, or import.
rules.applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities regardless of category or supply type.
rules.expected_condition: The manufacturing, packing, or import date must be declared and must be a valid, parseable date.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing manufacturing/packing/import date declarations. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Best Before / Use By Date
rules.description: Applicable categories must declare a best-before or use-by date.
rules.applicability: the product's category is Food & Beverages, Cosmetics & Personal Care, or Pharmaceuticals (OTC)
rules.expected_condition: For applicable categories, a best-before or use-by date must be declared and must be a valid, parseable date.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing best-before/use-by declarations for applicable categories. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Consumer / Customer Care Details
rules.description: The package must declare a consumer/customer care contact.
rules.applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities regardless of category or supply type.
rules.expected_condition: Consumer/customer care contact details must be present on the package.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing consumer care declarations. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Unit Sale Price
rules.description: Multi-piece packages must declare the unit sale price per piece.
rules.applicability: the declared net quantity indicates a multi-piece pack (e.g. '6 x 25 g')
rules.expected_condition: For multi-piece packages, the unit sale price per piece must be declared.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provision governing unit sale price for multi-piece packages. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.

rules.name: Declaration Readability & Font Size
rules.description: Declaration text must be prominent and legible; minimum font-size/height rules apply to several declarations.
rules.applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities; always shown for officer verification and excluded from the automated compliance score.
rules.expected_condition: Declaration text must meet applicable font-size and prominence requirements, verified via calibrated measurement.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — provisions governing minimum declaration font size/height. Prototype rule pack — verify against active official legal instruments before operational enforcement.
